_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Oli mukino wa Golf (Omuzanyo gw'Ekadi) - Omuzanyi {player_id}.
Gwe: Funa omuwendo gw'amaanyi asinga wansi mu mwezi guno. Bw'oba ntiisa za kikumi zina muwendo gwe gumu, zisibwa za sifuri.
Maanyi g'Ekadi: A=1, 2-10=muwendo wa kikumi, J/Q=10, K=0

Emikono (kozesa kawandi za kubaliza):
- '[draw]' - Kuwa ekadi ku kikwata
- '[take]' - Kuwa ekadi ku kikwata kya kikomya
- '[swap X Y]' - Kukyusa ekadi eyawudde na nafasi ya X (mukwata) Y (mukwata wa kikumi)
- '[discard]' - Kukomya ekadi eyawudde

board.drew:
Oyawudde: {card}
Kati wakati ono oteekwa okukozesa '[swap X Y]' oba '[discard]' ekadi eyo.
board.took:
Oyawudde: {card} ku kikwata kya kikomya
Oteekwa okukozesa '[swap X Y]' nayo (tokozesa kukomya).

options.final_turns: Mikono ya mwisho! Emikono gyo: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Olina: [swap X Y] (tosobola kusuula kaadi okuva mu kasasiro)

message.knocked: Omuzannyo {pid} gukubiddwa! Buli muzannya omulala afuna omutendera gumu.
message.final_round: Mchezaji {pid} {reason}! Kila mchezaji mwingine anapata mzunguko mmoja zaidi.

invalid.wrong_action: Guna kitondekiko kimu kimu: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], oba [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Ekisenge ky'ebintu ebyokebwa tekirina kintu kyonna!
invalid.must_draw_first: Lyawe kwanza ku [draw], [take], [knock], oba [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Toyinza kusuula kaadi eyaggibwa mu mpeke y'okuzuulibwa, olina okugiwa omulala.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Oli na kadi eyawudde. Oteekwa okukozesa '[swap X Y]' oba '[discard]' ekadi eyo.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Kifo kisukka mbuga. Guna safu 1-{max_row}, safu 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Tosobola kukomya kaadi ng'ogikuba, sooka omaliriza okukyusa.
